source.candidate_note: The assembled runtime candidate, reviewed and qualified as the release source. It carries the shared Qwen image preprocessing cache with its accepted corrections, the long-cached-prefix QSA prefill indexer optimisation and the hybrid partial-L3 prefetch guard above the published 3.1.5 lineage. The release preparation on top of it changes no runtime code: it moves the version asset and image defaults and adds the launcher, configurator, startup-file, Compose and report plumbing that makes the accepted optional cache pair reachable from Pennyroyal settings.

maintainer_ports.summary: QSA prefill indexer scores request-relative columns in long cached prefixes; an adaptation, not a cherry-pick, and the FP8 index-operand infrastructure of the upstream commit is not taken on this stable tree.
Hybrid HiCache revokes a storage hit it cannot stage whole.

integrated_main.note: Current main holds the integrated runtime. Its tree differs from the qualified candidate's only in formatter-identical files and one test comment; every measurement below stays attributed to the candidate source.

changes.summary: A shared, content-addressed CPU cache for multimodal preprocessing artifacts, behind --mm-preprocess-cache-dir and a positive --mm-preprocess-cache-size-mb. The store keeps its own index optional: a verified hit survives a failed recency stamp or commit, an index that cannot be read is a miss, and a lock shard that cannot be locked computes the artifact without publishing it. Caller-supplied content hashes never bypass source verification in shared mode, and a caller hash now replaces the padded prompt it describes rather than the token layout the scheduler owns.

The QSA prefill indexer writes request-relative logits instead of one workspace spanning every compressed key in the batch, so a long cached prefix no longer caps a row chunk at a few dozen rows and forces thousands of one-CTA scorer launches. Scores, top-k selection, causal masking, RoPE and the stall diagnostics are unchanged; the FP8 index-operand infrastructure of the upstream commit is not taken on this stable tree.
profiles: Flash-Next native MTP with QSA sparse attention

changes.summary: A hybrid storage hit that cannot be staged whole is revoked instead of shortened, because the SWA and Mamba component state at a shortened boundary is exactly what the hit query never proved. The request continues through ordinary admission and recomputes the uncached span; the KV-only fallback is unchanged. No corruption is claimed: completion validation already discarded the shortened recovery, and this avoids issuing the read.
profiles: Hybrid-Mamba launches (27B DFlash2 and Flash-Next) with the NIXL storage tier

changes.summary: The optional image preprocessing cache becomes a pair of ordinary Pennyroyal settings, PENNY_MM_PREPROCESS_CACHE_DIR and PENNY_MM_PREPROCESS_CACHE_SIZE_MB, read by all four native recipes and all four container startup files through one shared launcher helper, asked by the configurator, saved and reloaded like every other setting, and reported in the startup summary in MiB. Both default to off, so a launch that says nothing is the launch it was.
profiles: Every profile and both launch routes

validation.review: The assembled runtime is reviewed and qualified at the candidate head; this record adds no runtime claim beyond the measurements below.
validation.cpu: The focused merged CPU suites for the multimodal and manager scope pass: 137 tests with 25 subtests and one CUDA-only skip; the shared-processor, caller-hash, placeholder and hybrid prompt suites pass at 21 tests and 42 subtests. The release-launch integration adds its own CPU checks: the queue of settings through the real recipes, the mounted startup files and one generated container launch, the configurator save/reload, and the startup report.
validation.cuda: Five SM120 QSA numeric and selection checks pass on the built path (CUDA 13.4, GCC 15): the same scores and selected blocks as the previous indexer, in the retained-prefix shapes.
validation.serving: Both profiles served 18 reasoning responses each, all completing naturally, and passed the same agentic control run (6 model turns, 5 mock tool calls). Vision requests were run with the preprocessing cache off and then on, reusing one identical PNG with a changed prompt and a literal <image> tag, with preprocessing on a local RTX A4000 and CPU feature transport; a repeat of the same image was served from the shared directory, and cold-media timing was not measured. Retrieval passed at 63,906 and 489,921 tokens on both profiles. Cold-media timing was not measured, and no HTTP remote-encoder path is claimed.
validation.cache_restore: Host-tier restore returned 63,872 KV tokens and 2 Mamba states on both profiles (plus 2,048 sliding-window tokens on 27B); a fresh-process file restore returned 553,792 tokens and 4 Mamba states (plus 4,096 sliding-window tokens on 27B), and a duplicate of the same prompt answered 553,792 tokens from the device cache. Four replays at 64K and 490K returned correct answers with natural stops.
validation.caveats: Publication facts are pending, not favourable: no image, tag, digest, build run or promotion is recorded. The measured rows name their own launch conditions, and the prefill comparison is a prefill measurement on one profile rather than a decode claim.
validation.dependencies: No baseline or pin change in this release: docker/pennyroyal/native-baseline.json stays as published for 3.1.5, with the same 231 recorded distributions, and no dependency upgrade is included.
validation.public_main: main stands at f555efa62f6dbc578f1ce6485082351cd540cf25 with the integrated runtime; the release records here are prepared on candidate/3.1.6-validation-20261106 at 6c5cf32b51b6fead7b0760eba7486e6fb6c5e2cc, the measured source.

prefill_comparison.conditions: Flash-Next profile only, on the maintained 450 W native qualification recipe with adaptive 6/36 and the shared image cache on at 256 MiB; exactly 200,000 tokens cached on the device plus 4,000 new input tokens, prefilled in 4,096-token chunks; NIXL cache collection disabled and outside callers excluded.
prefill_comparison.claim: Fresh-input prefill tokens per second, a prefill measurement and not a decode rate.
